title: Human Pangenome Projection Parameters
description: Parameter schema for the human pangenome annotation projection pipeline

sample_sheet.description: Path to CSV sample sheet with columns: target_id,target_fasta (one row per target assembly)

ref_fasta.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA (e.g. GRCh38)

ref_gff.description: Path to the reference annotation GFF3 (e.g. GENCODE)

chromosomes.description: Optional comma-separated subset of chromosomes to project (e.g. 'chr20')

minimap2_preset.description: minimap2 preset for the whole-genome alignment, by divergence

hpp_container.description: Container image providing the hpp tool (built from containers/Dockerfile)

hpp_extra_args.description: Extra flags forwarded to the projection stages (e.g. rescue caps, thresholds)
